We need to propose a retrosynthesis route for target SMILES: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O

We must use templates in order: ['20810', '2895', '1914397', '1914398', '1914399', '74054'] and have at least 6 reactions. So we need 6 steps, each using those templates sequentially.

We have already applied 20810 to target, got precursors: ('CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1', 'O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F') Wait the result from apply_template 20810 gave a tuple of two SMILES: first is the big heterocycle with N etc, second is O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F (a sulfonyl chloride with fluorophenyl). Actually the target had O=S(N...)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O, i.e., sulfonyl attached to anilide? The template likely disconnections: sulfonyl chloride + aniline? The result shows sulfonyl chloride with Cl and fluorophenyl? Wait O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F is a sulfonyl chloride attached to fluorophenyl. Good.

Now next template 2895 applied to first precursor (the big heterocycle) gave nitrated aromatic? Actually result: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1 . So it introduced nitro group on aromatic.

Now template 1914397 applied to that gave two fragments: 'CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1' and 'O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2' . So it split the aromatic heterocycle into a protected amine (tert-butyl carbonate?) and a brominated phenyl fused ring with OH.

Now template 1914398 applied to the brominated fragment gave 'BrBr' and 'O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2' . So it removed Br? Actually gave BrBr as a byproduct and the same fragment without Br? Wait original had Br attached; after applying 1914398, we get BrBr (two bromine atoms) and the same core without Br (maybe dehalogenation). So the fragment becomes O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2.

Now template 1914399 applied to that gave 'O=C1CC2(CCC2)Oc2ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc21' . So it forms a carbonyl? Actually product is a lactone? Anyway.

Now we need final template 74054 to connect the two fragments from earlier steps? We haven't used 74054 yet. Need to retrieve template 74054.
